messages:
maria_cs: quick capture from today's Redleaf onboarding call — dropping raw asks here so we can triage into the backlog. main asks: per-route token cost visibility in console, ability to pin fallback models per-route, and a small UX tweak to show recent embedding version used.
kevin_onboarding: +1 on per-route cost visibility, customers keep asking during renewal reviews. any idea on data shape?
anya_support: they want cost broken down by model + route + time window (30/90/365). excel exports would be helpful.
sam_product: ok noted. Is this a quick win or needs infra work? sounds like metrics + export first.
eva_data: export + dashboard is medium effort — need a materialized view for per-request tokens by route/model. can prototype a nightly aggregate table.
maria_cs: also flagged: customer asked for an "embedding version" label on index metadata in the console (they have multiple re-indexes). small UI change but important for troubleshooting.
jamie_pm: propose we group into: 1) observability/export (per-route cost) 2) routing/policy (pin fallback model) 3) metadata UX (embedding version). priority candidate: observability for renewals.
sam_product: Agreed. For pin fallback, clarifying Q: do they mean per-route fallback override config (not global)?
kevin_onboarding: yes, per-route override — they run different SLAs per product. currently fallback is org-level and causes noisy failures during spikes.
eva_data: rough effort estimates: observability/export = 3 sprints (infra + UI), embedding-version tag = ~2 dev days + minor API change, per-route fallback = 4-6 sprints (routing + policy + tests).
anya_support: customers expect timeline during renewal — can we scope an MVP for observability that ships earlier? maybe export-only first.
sam_product: MVP plan: export CSV + basic per-route aggregates (no live dashboard) as Phase 1. Phase 2 add console table+time filters.
maria_cs: action items: eva to draft data spec for aggregates, sam to write product brief for export MVP, kevin to collect 3 renewal customer quotes to attach, jamie to slot triage review next Wed.
eva_data: will post data spec by EOD tomorrow.
triage-bot: reminder — create JIRA epic CS-OBS-1769 for "Per-route cost export MVP".
kevin_onboarding: pinging onboarding docs team — can someone paste the customer quote thread here? I want to highlight in renewal deck.
maria_cs: pasted below (redacted): "we need per-route billing to explain token usage to finance — current rollups are too coarse"
sam_product: thanks. I'll draft the brief and share before Friday. can we get support to surface any high-severity logs tied to fallback events?
anya_support: yes — I'll run a quick query for fallback errors last 30 days and attach samples to the ticket.
jamie_pm: tagging for prioritization: this maps to Q2 reliability OKR — will advocate during planning.
maria_cs: thanks team. will update customers with a short note: export MVP targeted in next release, we'll follow up with dates after triage. :thumbsup:
